dog: A golden retriever runs along a sandy beach at sunset, splashing through shallow waves, its ears flapping. Warm golden light, low angle tracking shot, cinematic.
boat: Close-up of a small red paper boat floating down a rain-soaked city street gutter, raindrops rippling the water, reflections of shop lights, shallow depth of field.
kitchen: A grandmother and her grandson bake bread together in a sunny kitchen, flour dusting the wooden table, the boy laughing as he kneads the dough. Handheld camera, natural light.
